product_metadata.title: Link Shades Anti-Slip Recliner Armchair Protector | Water Resistant Microsuede Slipcover | Stay-Put Straps | Cover Protects from Dogs & Other Pets (Recliner, up to 23" seat Size, Chocolate)
features: PRESERVE & PROTECT Innovative grip backing and multiple stay-put adjustable straps keep the cover securely in place to safeguard against spills, drips and other messes, dust and hair. Works with fabric, leather and faux leather. A must for homes with pets and kids.
VERSATILE USES Complement any room setting, from a living room to an RV. Compatible with a variety of styles, both armless & with arms: Lazy Boy loveseats, RV wall huggers and reclining couches.
EASY CARE & DURABLITY Water-repellent soft micro-suede fabric. Toss into the washer and dryer for easy care. Durable and long lasting.

FIND THE PERFECT FIT In addition to the Recliner size (up to 23" seat width), Link Shades furniture protectors come in Loveseat size (up to 50"), Sofa size (up to 72”), XL Sofa (up to 86”). Measure between seat cushions for best fit.
